_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 72.2% Dec 2020 transition analog plus ETF-driven institutional bid and DXY weakness support a continued climb up the ladder, but elevated VIX and low MVRV z-score mean this must earn conviction rather than assume it.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes — both agree on UP direction and risk-on regime, though the analyst is more cautious about structural divergences while the narrative writer leans cleaner bullish
next_move.confirmed_if: MVRV z-score climbs above 40 with funding staying below 70 and DXY breaking below 98.5
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 20 with BTC funding jumping above 0.015% and exchange netflow turning sharply positive (>70)
